Specification of Persistency
AUTOSAR AP R23-11
8.1.2 Installation and Update of Persistent Data
The
Persistency
installs/updates its
Key-Value Storages
and
File Storages
either during the validation of a freshly installed/updated
application
in the
ara::
per::UpdatePersistency
call, or when the
storages
are opened for the first
time. It allows to monitor these operations with a callback function installed with
ara::per::RegisterApplicationDataUpdateCallback
. The
application
may also restore the
Persistency
to the initial state (i.e. the state that it would have
if it was installed with the current
manifest
) with a call to
ara::per::ResetPer-
sistency
.
